nom: TULA Glow & Get It Cooling & Brightening Eye Balm

avis.texte: The eye balm acts more like a highlighter. For the price you're better off with Murad.
I got this in a BoxyCharm box years ago, and I've been hooked ever since. The cooling effect feels sooo nice underneath my eyes, especially when I'm feeling extra tired! 10/10
I tried taking a break and coming back but sure as heck it gives me hives and redness! I'm not allergic to anything so this is absolutely product specific

I was so excited to try this product after seeing rave reviews online, but I was disappointed shortly after testing it out—for the next 12 hours after trying out the product, I had intense hives and rashes on my face.
i love this stuff!! brightens my undereyes and leaves such a nice cooling effect!

I like the hydration and clean ingredients in this stick- gave it three stars for that. I do not like the blue shiny tint it leaves on my skin, I end up rubbing it all in or off to get rid of that. Will be returning at that price point.

avis.titre: Perfect for under eyes of aging skin
avis.texte: I use this under my eyes before my concealer. It stops my concealer from settling in my wrinkles and keeps it from drying out. I will purchase this again.

I was not expecting to like this product but I think its really good. I love the cooling effect and it definitely depuffed my morning eyes and brightened the area. I was a makeup artist for 15 years and i think this is a good product. I am in my 60's and have pretty bad dark circles and it really helps with that too .
Recommended by a friend, so decided to give it a try. Very refreshing - a great pick me up with a good cooling sensation. So glad I bought!
I love everything about this product. Cools, brightens, hydrates, minimizes fine lines, and is portable. Application is smooth and feels lovely.

avis.titre: PLEASE NEVER GET RID OF THIS PRODUCT
avis.texte: I cannot recommend this product enough!! Once I added this to my skincare my eyes really brightened and elevated a lot! I have extremely sensitive skin but this did wonders. I don't do my skin care without it.
Haven't been using but for a couple of days. Seems to make the darkness go away. Moisturizing. Doesn't feel heavy. I will probably buy again.

avis.titre: I will keep buying this product
avis.texte: This is my third purchase of this in two years or more. It lasts a long time and makes my eyes feel cool and refreshed. Only a small amount is needed so a little goes a long way. It awakens my eyes every morning after splashing my face with cold water applying.
I keep this product on my desk at work to make me feel more awake in the morning and the cooling effect is nice.
I keep this product on my desk at work to make me feel more awake in the morning and the cooling effect is nice.
Product does as it says it feels great under my eyes and is slightly highlighting
This causes an allergic reqction and set off severe rosacea flare.

I used it three times. I LOVED it, it was doing everything I had hoped for. And on the fourth time I broke out in itchy hives! Idk if I'm allergic to something in the product..?? Anyways, it was scary! Very disappointed because I really liked it :((

The formula must've changed after purchasing this a year or two ago. Two hours after applying, my eyes started to feel like I had sand in them, my under eyes broke out in hives, and the itching and burning persisted after cold compress, washing my face, rinsing my eyes, and a full nights sleep. 48 hours the swelling went down and the scratched eye sensation receded after antihistamines. Used to love this product! Returned and won't be purchasing again.

I have been curious about this product for several months and decided to finally splurge and try it. Wasnt sure what I expected but I love it! Super easy to apply looks great underneath or on top of make up or even alone on clean skin. Feels very cooling and definitely offers some brightening to the eye area once applied. I have very sensitive skin and I didn't have any issues using this.

Like other reviews say, results are not instant, but the benefits after a few weeks of consistent use make it all worth it! For someone who uses very light coverage tint, it adds a great glow that I use in place of concealer. The only problem I've had with it was I put it on one morning then went to the pool, and when it mixed with the chlorine it burned my under eyes sooo bad! So my only warning is do not wear in the pool! Bottom line.. I have already repurchased this bc I love it and I would definitely recommend this! *worth the price*

I bought this product on a whim, and I like it more than I expected! It instantly brightens and has a very nice cooling effect. Despite having sensitive skin, I didn't experience any negative reactions. I also appreciate that it can be worn over, under, or without makeup.
I bought this for the first time months ago. I recently placed a reorder - it's that good!

This product is awesome. I love how it feels and looks. Instantly makes me looks refreshed.

avis.titre: Love this product, but it gave me periocular dermatitis
avis.texte: I loveeee this product, especially for the early work mornings at 5 am and when i dont want to put on makeup, it gives a little glow snd is cooling. This was my second stick ive had. I started forming tons of red small dots around my eyes. It lasted for two months and all i could think of that was different was this product that i started using. Went to tne derm and that was his diagnosis, snd got a medicated gel. Sad, bc i loved this product sm😢

This is so easy to apply and makes my eyes look instantly refreshed. Being middle aged, my eyes often look tired and those under-eye bags are not getting smaller! However, this product helps to cool and calm all around my eyes with a little youthful glow. I love it!
I like the cooling effect that it has on my under eyes, and the slight shine it has as well. It makes me look more awake as well.

I really wanted to love this product, sadly, I find it just meh. When you first put it on, you get an instant cooling feeling but it is short lived. It does appear to brighten at first, however, it tends to leave a light white tint around your eyes. The price point is ridiculously high for a so-so product and such a small amount of product.
First time using this. I love it! Makes my eyes feel so awake!
Would definitely buy again. Has become a staple to my everyday routine!! Love the cooling effect and brightens under the eyes!
Love this product!!! Really works and I can see the difference in my eyes!
Instant wake up and super cooling. I have replaced all my skincare products with TULA products. This is one of my faves. Supper cooling and helps me stay eyes wide open. Not sticky, super hydrating!
I received this in my Allure Box, used it once and broke out on my under eyes the same day. It is an eczema like rash. This is the 2nd Tula product ive tried to cause a rash or break out.
This is my all time favorite product! It feels great and brightens my eyes!
Love this product! Makes my under eyes bright and have a cool feeling. I love the shine!
My all time fave product. Gives me a subtle glow that I get a lot of compliments on; I recommend Tula to everyone!
Love the cooling sensation of this eye balm. However, I don't notice much of a difference under my eyes before and after using.

Received as a free gift. This is truly the worst product I ever used in my life. I do not have sensitive skin by any means. My entire left eye is swollen itchy red from inner corners to my temple/hairline. It has been so painful and has gotten worse even after I quit using the product. Waiting on an appointment with the dermatologist, but have been taking benadryl in the mean time and receiving a little bit of relief. DO NOT BUY THIS !!
Cool feeling that is long lasting on skin. Easy application, will use throughout the day for a cooling feeling
This is also amazing! So cooling and brightens under the eye area!

I love it and use it every night it helps so much! I had really puffy dark eyes and the tula stick helped sooooo much! it cools and feels great! it doesn't burn or hurt or cause irritation like some products! has great ingredients! I luv it
Do not recommend at all. It didn't work and It turned the area around my eyes severely red and flaky. It took weeks of intensive moisturizing to recover, just in time for a wedding I was attending.

I very rarely love something enough to repurchase because I love trying new products! But eye products are love or hate for me! And this is a LOVE! It does have a cooling effect which I appreciate in the mornings, instantly brightens, and the texture is perfect! No pilling under my makeup and doesn't cause milia under my eyes for me which tends to happen often with eye products. Will be coming back for more!!
OMG life changing! I feel great when I apply it and love how I look when I wake up. I'm addicted!!

This is an amazing product. When you first put it on you feel a little tingle but then as it gets absorbed into your skin it feels so refreshing. And your eyes really do look better and brighter. If you are unsure if you should try it, don't hesitate! You will be glad you tried it
This eye balm is magical! I'm obsessed with how cooling it is and how it truly brightens up your under-eye area. Go buy it! You won't be sorry. Promise!
My dark circles have always been an issue. When I use the product, it does help decrease some of the visibility.

avis.titre: This product does what a promises
avis.texte: He has a cooling effect and makes your dark circles. Look brighter, and very soft to the touch.

avis.titre: Best under eye cream I've ever tried
avis.texte: I dont leave reviews unless i love something. I have dark circles, olive skin, it hydrates and looks so fresh on natursl skin or over makeup. I have recommended it to all my girlies. Love it 10/10

Recently transitioned to early morning workouts and was feeling tired and looking tired… My eyes are also sensitive and I get migraines and I have to say, using this product in the morning helps me feel and look alive, it soothes my skin and it may not solve my problem, but it actually alleviates some pain and tension from the cooling effect when a migraine kicks in. Never would've thought! Got more out of this product than I expected. Definitely recommend.
Love this cooling eye balm! It can feel it working with a little tingling feeling. I love Tula!

I don't normally buy products at this price, but I actually really love it. It's so easy to apply, and it has a cooling sensation and even brightens my under eyes. My makeup goes on really well over it. I have very dry under eyes and this eye balm works great.
This is a great product! It truly feels cooling to my under eye every time I use it.
Soothing and great under makeup ! Love that I can travel with it easy and it's very gentle . I have such sensitive eyes and this eye cream works great . Highly recommend!

avis.titre: I am on my second cooling
avis.texte: I am on my second cooling and brightening eye balm. I wake up really early in the morning and I have to honestly say are use it to wake up my eyes and get me ready for an hour. Long drive at 6 AM. It's like a little shot of caffeine for your eyes. Then you get a beautiful glow as well. So if you have tired eyes and you need a little brightening underneath this is the product for you and practice with your finger but I will tell you when I put it over my make up I use a dampended beauty blender and it goes on seamlessly. Make sure to keep the plastic cap that goes on the end. It will keep your product fresh!!
Love this! I use this daily to help with my dark circles under my eyes. this definitely makes my under eye look brighter and less puffy!
This stuff feels great under my eyes! I don't need to use any concealer when using this.

You get a cooling sensation for the first 10 seconds then instant burning that lasts a while. After a couple usues the burning never stopped and I started getting small dry flakey scabs under my eyes.
I love it! It feels cool and refreshing and really brightens up the under eye area!

So easy to use and small enough to pop in your handbag. It does exactly what it says on the tin and is really handy to cool your eyes if you've been out during hayfever season or been in front of your computer for too long.
I like the cooling feeling when you put it on. I don't personally think it helps with puffiness. I don't see a difference and I use it night and morning.
I use this every day! It helps me wake up a bit in the morning and I love the cooling sensation! It's a great pick me up.
Bought because I follow Alex Murphy. She uses it every day. I'm 74 and try to take care of my skin.

avis.titre: It's nice for like a minute
avis.texte: I do like how cooling it is when first applied, however shortly after theres like a dull burning sensation, almost like plumping lip gloss would feel. It doesnt last long either so im not sure if that's supposed to happen or if my skin is just too sensitive. I dont hate it, but i dont see any difference & will not repurchase
As a teacher who has to be up at 5 am, I LOVE this stuff! So cooling and hydrating! Helps to wake me up and start my day!

I tried this product multiple times and each time it breaks me out in hives under my eyes and causes irritation. The cooling sensation feels nice at first but it is then followed by hives. I don't recommend

This is the best eye treatment I've ever used. It goes on so smooth, no pulling on delicate eye skin. I use it day and night can already see a difference after 4 weeks. I highly recommend this product!
Feels good around eyes, easy to apply and not greasy. Waiting on some results. Will try a different eye balm next time.

avis.titre: Love the idea, hate the chemicals
avis.texte: Loved the application and the cooling at first, but then it would start to burn and tingle like a plumping lip gloss. on top of that it would also leave marks around my eyes in a light blue/white cast/tint. Definitely would not recommend to anyone who has sensitive skin/eyes.
I really love the cooling sensation of this under eye balm. It feels refreshing.

avis.titre: Excellent product for sensitive aging skin
avis.texte: Im in my late 40's and found this product to be litterally essential in my routine. I have extremely sensitive skin and I wear this product 2xs a day with nothing but positive results including cooling sensation, hydration, brightness, minimal lines showing. I use this with no concealer needed after! I was so tired of concealers looking awful and showing fine lines until I switched to using this product only and can't believe I dont need concealers anymore! It is an outstanding night regimen and I basically use it as a base for my eyeshadow and it works flawlessly. This is a staple for me!

avis.titre: I don't have sensitive skin & this still burned me!
avis.texte: As soon as I applied this my eyes became itchy, watery and burning. I do not have sensitive skin and tis purchase I immediately regretted. The burning hurt so bad and my eyes could not stop watering!

avis.titre: Feels nice but I don't no
avis.texte: Feels nice but I don't notice anything happening. Just not for me. I love all my other Tula products.
This product is not for darker complexions. It leaves a cast behind that is hard to cover.
One my most favorite products! I love how it feels under my eyes!
Kind of like cooling chapstick..didnt notice any significant results…didnt wear through the night either.

This is such a pleasant, cooling balm. I'm not sure how they do it, but it really does feel cool when applied. It does leave a pale "cast" behind, so this specific one might not be best for people with dark skin. I don't typically wear foundation, concealer, etc., so I found this gave a nice little shimmer and brightness under my eyes. However, I will say that I bought this when it was on sale for half off. I'm not sure it's worth it at full price if you don't want to splurge. I'm sure you can get the same effect with other products.
Love this product! Gives me a quick pick me up with bright, cooling feels!

This product caused a burning sensation and irritation under my eyes. I used to love the facial cleanser but it no longer works for me. I didn't see any change and the smell isn't pleasant. I would avoid this eye cream. Switching back to Mary Kay eye cream.
My skin is generally not super sensitive, but this immediateky makes my skin burn. Feels like a bad sunburn. I use the Sunday Riley autocorrect instead which doesn't have the same burning effect.
Looking for a replacement for a similiar priduct that was discontinued by Kopari. This is it. I love it. Already added another one to my cart.
Love Tula! Cooling and brightening eye balm is a must! Great product!

It's cooling but also irritating sometimes, not seeing any brightening effect, but it does leave a white cast which is annoying. Really don't like this product, but paid good $$ for it, can't wait till it's completely used up.
This lives up to everything described in the product description. Feels so good on skin when applying and leaves skin glowing and moisturized.
This eye balm is life changing. I've noticed such a huge difference in the dark circles under my eyes.

Lovely & so easy to use. I use it after applying moisturizing makeup, sun-screen etc. as a finishing touch under the eyes and down the front of my nose. Sometimes I use a bit on my forehead. Gives a wonderful natural looking glow & feels amazing going on.

I love this product! It is super quick and easy to use. It leaves the skin under your eyes feeling super plump and cooling sensation. It literally looks so natural and glowing. I feel like it has helped me keep healthier skin.

Honestly horrible product. It felt moisturizing in the moment maybe 29 seconds long. Then after reapplying it left me and my friends with a HORRIBLE allergic reaction. Do not buy this unless you want to look like you just got punched in the face. My eyes are still recovering.
Refreshing and cool. I have it out all day long and use it frequently. It doesn't build up. It leaves a subtle glow under my eyes. Love it.
I really like this product it adds a natural shine and is very cooling i love this i would totally recommend it

This glides on smoothly and feels cooling and refreshing. I love how it feels and would recommend it. I have very sensitive skin and have not had any negative reactions. I take it in my purse now and use it all the time.
it gives my eyes a fresh feeling and works great to remove any left over mascara.

cooling & brightening eye balm: I use this every morning before going to work. I watched it work in the mirror. Last a long time. Will order again! Something natural for women of color!:+1::skin-tone-5::+1::skin-tone-4::+1::skin-tone-6:

This is by far my favorite Tula Product! It is such a nice product and really helps eliminate the baggy feeling under the eyes. It feels cool (especially when refrigerated) and is very easy to carry around in a purse - the size is great. I recommend this to everyone!
This eye brighter is amazing!! Try it you will mot have any regrets.
